import numpy as np
def rollout(acts, n=256):
    obs, logits = observe(actions=acts, n_steps=n)
    T = obs.shape[0]
    green = obs[:,234:236]
    blue  = obs[:,26:28]
    red   = obs[:,104:106]
    dg = np.linalg.norm(green-blue,axis=1)
    dr = np.linalg.norm(green-red,axis=1)
    # green radius 0.22; blue half 0.207x0.382 -> approx touch dist ~0.42; red half 0.442x0.05 -> ~0.27
    succ = np.where(dg<0.42)[0]
    fail = np.where(dr<0.27)[0]
    print('T=',T,'first succ', succ[:3] if len(succ) else None, 'first fail', fail[:3] if len(fail) else None)
    return obs

for name,acts in [('always1',[1]*256),('always2',[2]*256),('always0',[0]*256)]:
